sections.heading: Pairs that trip up advanced learners

head: Words
Difference
rows: *ver* = to see (perceive); *mirar* = to look at (intentionally); *observar* = to observe closely: *Miré por la ventana pero no vi nada.*
*oír* = to hear; *escuchar* = to listen: *Te oigo, pero no te escucho.*
*pedir* = to ask for something / someone to do; *preguntar* = to ask a question: *Le pregunté la hora y le pedí un favor.*
*saber* = know facts / how to; *conocer* = be familiar with, meet: *Sé dónde vive, pero no lo conozco.*
*llevar* = take (away from speaker); *traer* = bring (toward speaker): *Tráeme agua y llévate esto.*
*quedar* = to be left / to arrange to meet / to fit; *quedarse* = to stay: *Quedan dos. Quedamos a las cinco. Me quedo aquí.*
*tardar* = to take (time — the subject is the person or thing); *llevar* = to have been (duration so far): *Tardé una hora. Llevo una hora aquí.*
*realizar* = to carry out; "to realize" is *darse cuenta*
all "achieve": *lograr* + infinitive (manage to), *conseguir* (obtain / manage), *alcanzar* (reach a goal / level)

sections.heading: Register differences
sections.body: Often one word is neutral and another formal: *empezar / comenzar / iniciar*, *terminar / finalizar / concluir*, *usar / utilizar / emplear*, *decir / afirmar / señalar*, *pedir / solicitar*, *ayudar / asistir* (in formal meaning), *buscar / indagar* (to investigate). Use the formal one in writing; in speech it may sound stiff.

examples: Miré por la ventana pero no vi nada.
I looked out the window but didn't see anything.
Los científicos observan el comportamiento de las aves.
The scientists observe the birds' behavior.
Te oigo, pero no te escucho.
I hear you, but I'm not listening to you.
Le pregunté la hora y le pedí un favor.
I asked him the time and asked him for a favor.
Sé dónde vive, pero no lo conozco.
I know where he lives, but I don't know him.
Tráeme agua y llévate esto.
Bring me some water and take this away.
Quedan dos boletos.
There are two tickets left.
Quedamos a las cinco en el café.
We arranged to meet at five at the café.
Esa camisa te queda muy bien.
That shirt looks really good on you.
Tardé una hora en llegar.
It took me an hour to get there.
Llevo una hora aquí.
I've been here for an hour.
Realizaron un estudio sobre el tema.
They carried out a study on the subject.
Por fin alcanzó su meta.
She finally reached her goal.
La sesión se inició a las nueve.
The session began at nine.
El informe señala varios problemas.
The report points out several problems.
